layout_system:
SHELL (.shell, min-height 100vh, box-sizing border-box): CSS grid with columns [var(--bar) | minmax(0,1fr) | var(--bar)] and rows [auto auto]. align-content start, gap 20px, padding 20px. --bar = clamp(57px, 5.13vw, 74px), which is 73.9px at 1440. Column 1 row 1 holds the context bar (aside.ctxbar, align-self start, position relative: it is not sticky and scrolls with the page). Column 2 row 1 holds the dashboard (.dash). Column 3 stays empty as a symmetric gutter matching the bar width. Row 2 holds the main bar, which spans 1 / -1, uses justify-self center and max-width 100%, is position sticky at bottom 20px, and has flex-wrap wrap and justify-content center. Because the content is shorter than the viewport, the main bar renders directly under the widgets (about 30px below them at 1440x934) rather than pinned to the viewport bottom.

DASHBOARD GRID (.dash): grid-template-columns repeat(12, minmax(0,1fr)), grid-auto-rows minmax(72px, auto), gap 20px, align-self start, min-width 0. Placement is plain auto-flow (no 'dense'). At 1440 the dash is about 1212px wide, so one column is about 82.7px. Spans come out as: 2 = 185px, 3 = 288px, 4 = 391px, 5 = 493px, 6 = 596px, 7 = 699px, 8 = 801px. Row spans are minimums because rows can grow with content: 2 rows = 164px, 3 = 256px, 4 = 348px, 5 = 440px. Each widget is a section.w (display flex, column, min-width 0, min-height 0, position relative; children min-width 0) with two size inputs. The first is an inline style 'grid-column: span N; grid-row: span R'. The second is a class cN (c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8) that the breakpoints override. There is no free-cell placeholder, no snapping, no drag and no resize implementation. The 6-dot grip in each header is decorative, and 'Resize', 'Arrange' and 'Layout' are inert.

SPANS USED. Overview: 3x2, 3x2, 2x2, 2x2, 2x2 (one row of 12), then 8x4 and 4x4. Mapping: 7x4 and 5x4, then 5x3 at cols 1-5 of the next band, leaving 7 columns empty. Analytics: four 6x3 widgets in a 2x2 grid. Prompts: 7x4 and 5x4, then 5x4 at cols 1-5 of the next band, leaving 7 columns empty. Rules: 8x5 and 4x5. Organizations: 8x4 at cols 1-8; 4x3 at cols 9-12, rows 1-3; 4x3 auto-placed at cols 9-12, rows 4-6.

BREAKPOINT ≤1180px: the shell drops the right gutter and becomes [var(--bar) | minmax(0,1fr)]. The dash becomes repeat(6, minmax(0,1fr)). Overrides: .c7 and .c5 become span 6 (full width); .c4 and .c3 become span 3 (half). There is NO override for .c2 (stays span 2 of 6), .c6 (span 6, which fits) or .c8 (span 8 in a 6-column grid, which creates implicit columns and overflows; affects Recent audit events, Actions & credits and Organizations table).

BREAKPOINT ≤720px (phone): the shell becomes a single column, minmax(0,1fr). Row 1 is the context bar, now a horizontal strip: width auto, flex-direction row, flex-wrap wrap, align-items center. Its header block takes flex 1 1 100% with no bottom border or margin, so kicker and title sit on their own line, and the tool buttons sit side by side at width 4.3em. Row 2 is the dash with grid-template-columns minmax(0,1fr). .c7, .c5, .c4 and .c3 become span 1. There is NO override for .c2, .c6 or .c8, so they keep span 2, 6 or 8 in a one-column grid and generate implicit columns (a layout defect). Row 3 is the main bar with justify-self stretch, gap 4px, still sticky at bottom 20px and wrapping. Row spans (inline grid-row) are unchanged on phone. An unused .guide rule sets width calc(100vw - 40px) and max-height 45vh on phone; no guide element exists on this board.

The toolbars scale by ratio: 1em = clamp(10px, 0.9vw, 13px), about 13px at 1440. No phone action sheet is defined on this board.
chrome: CONTEXT (LEFT) BAR: <aside aria-label="Selected widget tools" data-guide="ctxbar" class="ctx ctxbar">. z-index 1, flex column, align-items stretch, inline width 74px (CSS forces 100% of the --bar column), gap 4px (CSS .31em), padding 10px 8px (CSS .77em .62em), bg SURFACE, 1px LINE border, radius 12, .ctx shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(14,21,62,0.10). Placed in shell column 1, row 1, top-aligned beside the first widget row.

CONTEXT BAR HEADER: a block with padding 4px 4px 8px, 1px LINE bottom border and margin-bottom 4px. Line 1 is the kicker {{ctxKicker}}: 10px/800 uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em, NAVY, line-height 1.2. It reads 'Dashboard' when nothing is selected and 'Widget' when a widget is selected. Line 2 is the title {{ctxTitle}}: 12px/800, line-height 1.2, margin-top 2px, overflow-wrap anywhere. It reads 'Nothing selected' or the selected widget's context title. In the PDF render 'DASHBOARD' overflows the bar's right edge and 'Nothing selected' breaks as 'Nothing / selecte / d'.

CONTEXT BAR TOOLS, NOTHING SELECTED (all non-primary: transparent bg, MUTED icon and label): 'Add' (plus icon), 'Arrange' (layout 2x2 squares icon), 'Reset' (circular-arrow reset icon), 'Lock' (padlock icon). Each is a <button class="tool" aria-label="{label}">: flex column, centred, gap 3px, min-height 52px (CSS 4em), padding 6px 2px, radius 12, border 0, 22px icon, 10px/700 label centred with line-height 1.1. All run handlers are no-ops (run: () => {}).

CONTEXT BAR TOOLS, WIDGET SELECTED: the widget's own tool list from the CTX table (see each widget's left_bar_actions). The tool flagged primary is listed first and gets bg RED #BD2025 with white icon and label; the others are transparent with MUTED colour. Below them, rendered only when hasSel, is a 1px LINE divider (margin 4px 0) followed by four generic widget tools, all transparent with MUTED colour, min-height 48px and a 20px icon: 'Pin' (aria-label 'Pin widget', pushpin icon), 'Resize' (aria-label 'Resize widget', diagonal arrows icon), 'Hide' (aria-label 'Hide widget', eye-off icon), 'Esc' (aria-label 'Deselect', 18px X icon at stroke 2, min-height 44px, 1px LINE border). Pin, Resize and Hide have no handlers. Esc calls clear(), which sets selected to 'none'.

MAIN (BOTTOM) BAR: <nav aria-label="Dashboard" data-guide="mainbar" class="ctx mainbar">. z-index 1, flex row, align-items center, gap 4px (CSS .31em), padding 8px (CSS .62em), bg SURFACE, 1px LINE border, radius 12, .ctx shadow, sticky at bottom 20px, centred, wraps. Order left to right: logo, 'Console' label, separator, 6 page tabs, separator, 4 utility buttons, separator, 2 console-switch links, separator, account button.
MAIN BAR logo: <a href="Super.dc.html" aria-label="S3 home">, 44x44 (CSS 3.4em), radius 12, holding the S3 brand image (alt 'S3', height 34px, CSS 2.6em).
MAIN BAR label 'Console': span, 11px/800 uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em, MUTED, padding 0 6px, nowrap. It renders as 'CONSOLE'.
MAIN BAR separators: div 1px wide, 28px high (CSS 2.15em), bg LINE, margin 0 4px (CSS 0 .31em). There are four.

MAIN BAR page tabs: <button class="main">, position relative, height 44px, padding 0 14px, radius 12, border 0, 13px/800, nowrap. Active tab: bg NAVY #0E153E, text #fff. Inactive: bg transparent, text MUTED. Labels in order: 'Overview' (go_overview, default active), 'Identity mapping' (go_mapping), 'Research analytics' (go_analytics), 'System prompts' (go_prompts), 'Gamification rules' (go_rules), 'Organizations' (go_organizations). Clicking a tab switches the page and clears the selection. The tabs have no icons. RENDER DEFECT: the ratio CSS '.mainbar>button.main{width:4.9em;height:3.7em}' is meant for icon buttons but also hits these text tabs, forcing each to about 64px wide. The labels overflow and overlap each other in the PDF (only 'Overview' is partly readable, in the navy pill).

MAIN BAR badge on 'Identity mapping': an absolutely positioned span, top 4px, right 6px, min-width 16px, height 16px, padding 0 4px, radius 12, bg RED, white 10px/800, line-height 16px, centred text '3' (count of unlinked profiles). RENDER DEFECT: the ratio CSS forces it to .62em x .62em at top .46em, right 1.08em, so it renders as a clipped red sliver with the '3' cut off.

MAIN BAR utility buttons (<button class="main">, flex column, gap 2px, 64x48, radius 12, transparent, MUTED, 22px icon above a 10px/700 label), all without handlers: 'Add' (aria-label 'Add', plus icon), 'Layout' (aria-label 'Layout', 2x2 grid icon), 'Search' (aria-label 'Search', magnifier icon), 'Theme' (aria-label 'Theme', crescent-moon icon).

MAIN BAR console-switch links (<a>, flex column, gap 2px, 64x48 inline but forced to 3.4em square by '.mainbar>a', radius 12, MUTED, no underline, 10px/700 with a 22px icon above): 'Org admin' (users icon, href 'Admin.dc.html') and 'Crew app' (plane icon, href 'Main.dc.html'). In the render the squeeze wraps the labels to 'Org / admin' and 'Crew / app'.

MAIN BAR account button: <button aria-label="Account: Super admin, All organizations">, flex, gap 10px, height 44px, padding 0 12px 0 4px (CSS 0 .92em 0 .31em), transparent. It contains a 36px circular avatar (CSS 2.77em), bg NAVY, white 13px/800 initials 'SA', then two lines: 'Super admin' (13px/800) and 'All organizations' (11px, MUTED), line-height 1.15. No menu or handler is defined.
There is no guide or Play button on this board's bars and no badge other than the 'Identity mapping' count. No top bar exists; the only chrome is the left context bar and the bottom main bar.

interactions: STATE MODEL: Component extends DCLogic. state = { page: 'overview', selected: 'none' }. PAGES = ['overview','mapping','analytics','prompts','rules','organizations']. KEYS (22 widget ids) = orgs, users, linked, unlinked, sessions, audit, health, unlinkedw, mappings, walllog, dims, byorg, bycat, bytype, versions, playground, newversion, rules, tierrules, orgtable, neworg, newadmin. renderVals() derives sel_<key>, pick_<key>, pg_<page>, go_<page>, tab_<page>_bg and tab_<page>_fg, plus ctxKicker, ctxTitle, tools, hasSel and clear.

PAGE SWITCH: clicking a main-bar tab calls go_<page>, which sets { page: p, selected: 'none' }. Only the widgets of the active page render (via <sc-if value={{pg_<page>}}>). The active tab turns NAVY with white text; the others are transparent with MUTED text. There is no URL or route change, no transition and no animation.

SELECT: each widget header is a full-width <button> (aria-label 'Select widget: <Title>'). Clicking it sets selected = key. The selected widget gets a 2px NAVY inset ring (absolute overlay, radius 12, pointer-events none). The context bar switches its kicker from 'Dashboard' to 'Widget', shows the widget's context title, and replaces the tool list with that widget's tools (primary in red first). Pin / Resize / Hide / Esc are appended below a divider. Clicking the header of an already-selected widget keeps it selected; there is no toggle. Only one widget can be selected at a time.

DESELECT: the 'Esc' tool (aria-label 'Deselect') calls clear(), which sets selected to 'none' and restores the 'Dashboard' / 'Nothing selected' tools (Add, Arrange, Reset, Lock). Switching page also deselects. There is NO keyboard Escape listener (no keydown handler anywhere in the bundle), so 'Esc' is only a label.

CONTEXT TOOL ACTIONS: every CTX tool has run: () => {}, a no-op. That covers Add, Arrange, Reset, Lock, Open, New org, Export, Mapping, Map now, Analytics, Filter, Older, Refresh, Prompts, Link, Auto-match, Skip, Unlink, Export CSV, All 16, Activate, Rollback, Diff, Run, Clear, Save, Save all, Add rule, Revert, Add tier, Create and Invite. The generic Pin / Resize / Hide tools have no handler.

IN-WIDGET CONTROLS: the 'Link', 'Run test', 'Save version', 'Create' and 'Invite admin' buttons, the selects, inputs and textareas are native and unbound (no handlers or state). Row actions 'Unlink', 'Rollback' and 'Activate' are plain text in table cells, not controls.

MAIN BAR: 'Add', 'Layout', 'Search' and 'Theme' have no handlers, and the account button has no handler. Navigation links: the S3 logo goes to 'Super.dc.html' (console home), 'Org admin' to 'Admin.dc.html', and 'Crew app' to 'Main.dc.html'.

DRAG / RESIZE / ARRANGE / RESET / LOCK / ADD-FROM-LIBRARY / SEARCH / THEME: represented only by buttons and the 6-dot grip affordance; no behaviour is implemented. There is no widget library, no persistence and no localStorage.

HOVER: CSS defines .tool:hover and .main:hover with background oklch(0.975 0.006 275). Every such button also sets background inline (transparent, RED or NAVY), and the inline style wins over the class rule, so the hover tint never shows. a:hover colour is #09102E.

FOCUS / KEYBOARD: elements are native buttons and links, so Tab, Enter and Space work for selecting widgets and switching pages. No custom focus ring is defined (the browser default applies). aria-labels exist on the bars, the tools and all header buttons. The tab buttons have no aria-current or aria-pressed.
ANIMATIONS: none. No transitions or keyframes are defined.
GUIDE: no guide on this board. The data-guide anchors and a .guide CSS rule exist only as hooks (see guide_steps).
guide_steps: None defined on this board. The superadmin script has no STEPS array, no guide state and no guide card markup. Guide steps exist only in the desktop and guide boards.

Guide anchor hooks present (data-guide attribute values) that a guide could target: ctxbar, mainbar, orgs, users, linked, unlinked, sessions, audit, health, unlinkedw, mappings, walllog, dims, byorg, bycat, bytype, versions, playground, newversion, rules, tierrules, orgtable, neworg, newadmin.

open_questions: Main-bar tab sizing: the ratio rule '.mainbar>button.main{width:4.9em;height:3.7em}' squeezes the six text tabs to about 64px and makes them overlap (page6.png). Should tabs size to their content (padding 0 14px, height 44px as inline), or become icon + short label like the utility buttons? The current app nav already has icons (gauge, link, chart, terminal, award, building).
Tab count badge: the ratio CSS shrinks it to a .62em dot and clips the '3'. Should the badge be a numeric pill (16px high, red, white 10px/800) or a plain dot?

Context-bar header wrap: at 74px wide, 'Nothing selected' breaks mid-word because of overflow-wrap anywhere, and 'DASHBOARD' overflows. Should the bar be wider, or should the title be allowed to clamp or ellipsize?
'Esc' is only a button label; there is no Escape-key handler. Should pressing Escape deselect, as the label implies?

None of the canvas tools work: Add, Arrange, Reset and Lock (nothing selected); Pin, Resize and Hide (selected); Add, Layout, Search and Theme (main bar). What is the intended behaviour, and is the layout persisted per user, per page or per console? Is there a widget library for 'Add'?
Theme button but no dark tokens on any board: should dark values be derived from the existing app theme (src/lib/theme), or is a dark palette still to be designed?
Auto-match tool icon references I.search, which is undefined, so the icon renders empty. Use the main-bar magnifier path 'M11 19a8 8 0 1 0 0-16 8 8 0 0 0 0 16zM21 21l-4.3-4.3'?
The context title for rules is the JS string 'Actions & credits', which a text binding will show literally. It should be 'Actions & credits'.
The context title for bycat is 'By category' while the widget title is 'By operational category'. Which is intended?

Bar scaling: 'Dimension averages' fills are scaled to the largest value (46 → 65%, 71 → 100%) although the meta says '0–100 preference score'. Should the fill equal the score (46%), as the current ProgressBar does?
Readiness tiers: Bronze shows the value '0.01' while its label says '0'. Is this a typo for '0'? Fills are scaled to Platinum (1200).

Breakpoints have no overrides for .c2, .c6 and .c8. c8 (Recent audit events, Actions & credits, Organizations table) overflows the 6-column grid at ≤1180, and c2/c6/c8 overflow the 1-column grid at ≤720. Intended spans: c8 → 6 at ≤1180; everything → 1 at ≤720; c2 → 2 or 3 at ≤1180?
Hover tints (.tool:hover, .main:hover) never show because of inline backgrounds. Should hover use the CANVAS tint as the CSS intends?

Row actions are plain text: 'Unlink' (Active mappings), 'Rollback' and 'Activate' (Prompt versions). Should they be buttons with the current confirm dialogs ('Unlink <name>?', 'Activate <family> v<n>?'), or only context-bar tools that act on a selected row? Row selection inside a widget is not designed.

Rules and tiers are drawn read-only, while the current app edits them inline. Does the 'Save all' / 'Revert' / 'Add rule' tool set imply an edit mode that turns cells into inputs? 'Add rule' and 'Add tier' have no backend equivalent today: rules are keyed by action_type and tiers are fixed at bronze, silver, gold and platinum.
'Activate immediately: off' is static text. Should it be a toggle (current app: ChipChecks 'Activate immediately')?
Analytics filters (Organization / Gender / Category) and the 'By gender' table from the current page are absent. Does 'Filter' open a filter popover, and is 'By gender' dropped intentionally?

The Identity mapping organization switcher from the current page is absent, and the Unlinked list mixes Skyline and Northwind profiles. Is the wall now cross-organization by default? The candidate user list in the current app is per organization.

Mapping row subline 'Skyline · ADAPT' / 'Northwind · MBTI II' uses short org names and framework labels. The current app shows framework and created date, plus candidate name and email (not a truncated 'hint: n.peretz@…'). Confirm what identity hint is shown.
The NWA-1A2B-55 select has two identical 'Choose a user…' options, which looks like a sample-data slip. In the current app the placeholder is a disabled 'Select user…'.
Active mappings: tokens are not monospace here (they are mono in Unlinked profiles) and user emails are not shown (the current app shows them). Which should it be?
Identity audit log shows user names ('→ Dana Cohen'), while the current app shows user email and an actor line ('by …'). Which identity field, and should the actor be shown?

Audit dot colours differ from the current actionTone mapping: prompt.activate is green (current 'acc'), rule.update is red (current 'acc'), org.create is navy (current 'ok'). Define the canonical tone per action family.

Sample-data inconsistencies: Users 212 vs 198 crew + 9 admins = 207 (5 unexplained, perhaps super admins). Demo · Sandbox has 28 reports but only 18 crew. Analytics 'By organization' lists 'Unassigned' n=28 instead of 'Demo · Sandbox'. The 'New organization admin' select omits 'Demo · Sandbox'.
